description: Header file defining the SwapChainPanelNativeWindow class and related event handler for managing ISwapChainPanel native window types in a Direct3D 11 WinRT environment, including size change handling.

classes.name: SwapChainPanelNativeWindow
classes.description: A class managing a native swap chain panel window for Direct3D rendering in WinRT.

classes.name: SwapChainPanelSizeChangedHandler
classes.description: Event handler class for handling size change events of the swap chain panel.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the native window with a given EGL native window type and property set.

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Creates a swap chain with specified device, factory, format, size, and alpha settings.

methods.name: scaleSwapChain
methods.description: Scales the swap chain based on window size and client rectangle.

methods.name: registerForSizeChangeEvents
methods.description: Registers for size change events on the swap chain panel.

methods.name: SwapChainPanelSizeChangedHandler
methods.description: Handles size change events for the swap chain panel.

methods.name: RuntimeClassInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the size change handler with a shared pointer to the native window.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Event handler method called when the size of the swap chain panel changes.

methods.name: GetSwapChainPanelSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the swap chain panel.
